brief:
The United Arab Emirates has confirmed a visit by Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, Middle East Eye reported, marking the first official acknowledgement of such a trip. The announcement made no reference to ongoing regional conflicts or wars in the statement.

The visit follows earlier reports that Emirati President Sheikh Mohamed bin Zayed had warned Netanyahu of a potential Hamas operation before the 7 October attacks.
